title: Aries tried to fight the ocean.
caption: Jealousy, sadness, anxiety. Aries tries to headbutt, outpaddle and STOP-sign every wave, and wipes out every time. Feelings come in waves: ride them, say them out loud, and trust that they pass. Send this to the friend who fights every feeling.
